metadata.description: o-MATIC Server Connection plus the core crew. One install configures the existing o-MATIC Server MCP connection (cloud default, or an operator-entered on-prem URL) and loads Probot, Fred, and Data. It does not create a Server, dispatch agents, or change authentication.
